changeSet.author: claude (P4-14)
changeSet.comment: Marketplace terms acceptance (decided 2026-10-04). Clients must have the user accept the marketplace terms before marketplace use, and the backend records it: marketplace_agreement_accepted is the current state (false = never accepted or withdrawn; withdrawing hides the user's listings in ms_marketplace), marketplace_agreement_version is which terms text was accepted (sent by the client), and marketplace_agreement_accepted_at is the server time of that acceptance. On withdrawal only the flag goes false: version and time stay as the record of the last acceptance. DEFAULT false backfills existing rows as not accepted - the marketplace is opt-in. VARCHAR(50) for the version, which is an identifier like 2026-10-01 or v3, not text.
